probes.check: am_probe_mimalloc_diagnostics(): mimalloc prints its options (mi_options_print) and the facade receives the lines; mimalloc has no query for its output function.

seeded_violation.description: Remove the mi_register_output call from am_bind_mimalloc_diagnostics().

adaptation_notes: mimalloc writes a line's prefix ("mimalloc: warning: ") and its message in separate calls to the output function; the glue collects each line per thread and logs it at the level the prefix names.
mimalloc holds output written before mi_register_output and hands it to the function when it registers, so nothing printed in the memory phase is lost.
mimalloc's asserts (mi_assert, under MI_DEBUG) print through the registered output and abort; no runtime hook changes that.
